summary: Alarum Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing materials for its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, an Israeli equivalent of a US annual meeting proxy statement, to be held December 30, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. Israel time with a record date of December 1, 2026. Agenda items are routine: re-appointment of PwC Israel as independent auditor with board authority over remuneration, re-appointment of Class I directors Rakefet Remigolski and Yehuda Halfon to three-year terms, and presentation of 2025 financial statements. The board recommends voting in favor. No transaction, stake, price, or special-situation mechanics are present.
